professionalSummary: Product analytics analyst with three years of experience at a streaming company, building and maintaining engagement dashboards across phone, tablet, and TV platforms for nine product managers.
Defined event tracking for fourteen new features in collaboration with app teams, following the company’s tracking standard and filing specifications in the analytics repository.
Analyzed feature launches against success metrics under the team’s analysis standard, with reviews by the head of product analytics and decisions made by product managers.
Prepared weekly product review packs, clearly attributing analyses to self or to the data platform team’s pipelines.
Documented limitations for each launch analysis and hand‑over notes for dashboards passed to other analysts.
experienceHighlights: Built and maintained engagement dashboards for phone, tablet, and TV apps used by nine product managers.

Prepared weekly product review packs, recording ownership of analyses.
